{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    h = rng.randint(3, 8)
    w = rng.randint(3, 8)
    grid = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # Produce sparse, varied ARC-style colored objects on a zero background.
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, max(2, (h*w)//4))):
        r = rng.randrange(h)
        c = rng.randrange(w)
        grid[r][c] = rng.randint(1, 9)
    return grid"}
